g.text: Bars: separate DiT profiling, normalized over actual forwards × 50 blocks; no E2E extrapolation. Offload policy: omni-layer-prefetch1-vae-resident-v1.

g.text: All methods: eight forwards, one reviewed seed, trained schedules. Module spans include waits; bars are not isolated kernel compute.
